title: A concurrent resolution providing for a joint session of the Congress in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on Thursday, July 2, 2026, in honor of the semiquincentennial of the Declaration of Independence.
latestAction: Referred to the Committee on Rules and Administration. (text: CR S3221)
summary: This concurrent resolution provides for a joint session of Congress to be assembled at the Independence National Historical Park in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on Thursday, July 2, 2026, in commemoration of the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence.

actions.text: Referred to the Committee on Rules and Administration. (text: CR S3221)
